data.one_liner: Lightweight cross-platform secure local JSON storage for collections and documents.
data.what_it_does: Local Shared is a secure wrapper for JSON file-based local storage that provides CRUD operations for collections and documents, batch operations, migration semantics, and stream updates across all platforms.
use_when: You need secure local JSON storage for collections and documents.
You require stream-based observation of changes in local collections.
You want cross-platform support including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
avoid_when: You need a full relational SQL database with complex querying capabilities.
You require high-performance raw key-value caching without JSON overhead.
strengths: Tested CRUD operations for both collections and single/multiple documents.
Built-in stream updates for observing data changes.
Security hardening with resilient keystore handling and auto-wipe mechanisms.
weaknesses: Relies on JSON file-based wrapping which may not scale for massive datasets.
Limited to specific collection and document structures provided by the package API.
data.setup_notes: Initialize the LocalShared instance in your main function after ensuring Flutter is properly initialized.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a simple, native key-value store without structured JSON collections.

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need secure key-value storage rather than a structured JSON collection and document database.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you require a full relational SQLite database for complex queries and high performance.
